map.失眠严重程度指数(ISI)，评估最近两周失眠症状的性质与严重程度。共7题，每题0: Insomnia Severity Index (ISI) assesses the nature and severity of insomnia symptoms over the past two weeks. 7 items, 0-4 each, total 0-28.
map.ISI失眠严重指数 = Σ7个条目（每项0-4，满分28）；≤7无失眠、8-14: ISI = sum of 7 items (0-4 each, max 28); <=7 no insomnia, 8-14 subthreshold, 15-21 moderate, 22-28 severe.
map.关注睡眠卫生，必要时干预: Attend to sleep hygiene, intervene if needed
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代睡眠医学专业诊断。长期失眠建议就诊睡眠门诊。: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace sleep-medicine diagnosis. For chronic insomnia, see a sleep clinic.
map.7 项 0–4：入睡2、维持2、早醒2、满意2、干扰2、明显度2、损害2 = 1: 7 items 0-4: onset 2, maintenance 2, early-wake 2, satisfaction 2, interference 2, noticeability 2, impairment 2 = 14, moderate insomnia; sleep hygiene + CBT-I advised.
map.多项 3–4 合计 21，重度，合并日间功能明显受损，需专业失眠门诊。: Several 3-4 items total 21, severe, with marked daytime impairment; needs a specialist insomnia clinic.
map.0–7 无，8–14 轻/中，15–21 中/重，22–28 极重；以总分结合日: 0-7 none, 8-14 mild, 15-21 moderate, 22-28 extreme; combine total with daytime impairment to set intervention intensity.
map.失眠认知行为治疗，一线非药物疗法，包含刺激控制、睡眠限制与认知重构。: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia, first-line non-drug therapy, including stimulus control, sleep restriction and cognitive restructuring.
map.睡眠(ISI)失眠严重度评估器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Insomnia Severity Index (ISI). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.

map.用于筛查失眠严重程度与疗效随访；分数升高提示睡眠启动/维持困难及日间功能受损加重: Used to screen insomnia severity and track treatment response; rising scores signal worse sleep onset/maintenance difficulty and daytime impairment.
map.ISI 为自评筛查，分级阈值为常用参考；确诊与治疗方案需由睡眠专科结合多导睡眠图: ISI is a self-report screen; its thresholds are common references. Confirmation and treatment need a sleep specialist with polysomnography etc.
